name: Thunder Axe Fortress
summary: Burning Blade cultists hold Thunder Axe Fortress in northwestern Desolace. They guard the wastes from its stone barracks and watchtowers, with darkened caves below.

sections.title: A Bastion of the Burning Blade
sections.body: In northwestern Desolace, Burning Blade cultists keep watch over the wastes from Thunder Axe Fortress. Stone barracks and watchtowers fortify the compound, and deep caverns run beneath it. Far from Kalimdor’s major cities, the cult gathers fel energies and summons lesser demons. Its members scheme to bring more dangerous entities into the world.

sections.title: Stolen Relics and Dark Summonings
sections.body: The Hand of Iruxos lies at Thunder Axe Fortress, bound to the demonic portals of Mannoroc Coven. A Burning Blade seer studies the stolen Sceptre of Light atop a watchtower. Azore Aldamort asks travelers to recover it. Rumor says the naga once held the sceptre.

aliases: who is in thunder axe fortress
faq.answer: The Burning Blade cult controls Thunder Axe Fortress. Its members serve demonic power and the remnants of the Shadow Council. Warlocks such as Tyranis Malem oversee the fortress and its operations.

faq.q: What is the Sceptre of Light?
faq.answer: The Sceptre of Light is an ancient artifact said to be able to sink entire cities beneath the sea. Azore Aldamort asks travelers to retrieve it from a Burning Blade seer studying it atop a watchtower at Thunder Axe Fortress.

faq.q: How is this fortress connected to Mannoroc Coven?
faq.answer: Cultists at Thunder Axe Fortress hold the Hand of Iruxos, a relic directly linked to the demon portals active at Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace. The artifact binds their demonic efforts across the zone.

angles.text: As a Warlock, you can see how recklessly the Burning Blade experiments with demonology. They bind lesser fiends and force planar rifts for greater entities.
As an Alliance traveler, you can help the Argent Dawn secure dangerous artifacts like the Sceptre of Light before fel cultists turn them against the continent.
